item.content:encoded:
The Saline Home Builders Association is preparing to host its 2026 “Fore the Builders” Golf Tournament on Thursday, Sept. 17, at the Hurricane Golf & Country Club.

The upcoming community event features two separate flights, meals for participants, and various prize opportunities. Read more below.




The tournament will host two scheduled flights for teams. Morning participants can check in and enjoy breakfast during the 8 a.m. registration period, with the first flight officially teeing off at 8:30 a.m.

Afternoon players will have a separate registration and lunch starting at noon, followed by the second flight at 1 p.m.

The team entry fee is set at $450. Additionally, attendees can purchase a separate game package for $60. The tournament will conclude with the distribution of prizes and awards to the participating golfers.

Those interested in registering a team or seeking further information about the event can contact Amy with the Saline Home Builders Association by calling 501-909-8055 or emailing salinehba@gmail.com.
